notes.title: Album Release and Music Master
notes.content:
The soundtrack for Messorem is now finally available for purchase and streaming! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840152/e96851a0b10508323d695bd5cca1a550c7004cf7.jpg[/img]

The full soundtrack available on Steam contains 78 minutes of live-recorded music, featuring everything heard in the game along with extras!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592620/Messorem_Sounds_From_The_Afterlife/#app_reviews_hash

The soundtrack can also be streamed on a streaming platform of your choice for free!

https://indigoboom.eu/0pr2dw7


Along with the release of the soundtrack, we have updated the game to include the final masters of all songs.

[list]
[b]Highlight[/b]
[*] All songs are now fully mastered and live-recorded music.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed a broken gate in the boss arena that caused the game to  lock up
[*] The Dragon can no longer be pushed out of the arena. It will teleport back to the middle if it escapes.

[b]Minor changes[/b]
[*] Fixed visuals on relevant gates
[*] Adjusted water effect in intro scene and in level 1-2
[/list]

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played the game! We are still working to fix a couple of bugs, here are a few fixes.

If you haven't completed the game and don't want to play through everything to get back to the point you were. You can press the letter "O" in the very first scene (Cemetery) to open up a level select.

A proper level select will likely come in the future

Fixes
[list]
[*] The boss should now always initiate combat.
[*] Fire arenas will no longer automatically complete combat
[*] cleaned up art in a few levels
[*] Fixed an issue where player would be stuck in dialogue during combat in level 1-1
[/list]

If you encounter any issues, feel free to tell us what happened and how if possible!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Random collider in 2-3 now removed
[*] Enemy should no longer be able to attack you during dialogue
[*] Ending music will now end properly and transition into Shimmer
[/list]

There is a few bugs we are aware of and we will be working to solve them as soon as possible

notes.title: VOCAL TRACKS FROM SHINE NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Our two Vocal tracks are now live on streaming services!!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840152/c49579a8890fb19f2ff95eb8485a79a8891cd0fc.png[/img]


LISTEN NOW: https://indigoboom.eu/7pb1p3k


The soon-to-be music phenomenon SHINE provides the music with the «Sounds From The Afterlife - Concept Album For Messorem».

The norwegian 8-piece delivers an astounding 65+ minutes of live orchestrated music that paints the world of the game with a magical assortment of sounds, genres-variety and instrumentation.

The complete Sounds From The Afterlife - Concept Album For «Messorem» will be available in it’s entirety in Q1 2025 on your streaming platform of choice.

SHINE brings the action and drama to new levels with the two vocal-tracks «The Final Hour» and «Shimmer».
From blistering speed-metal to folky J-pop undertones, the band delivers audible spectacle like no first-time Indie game has ever seen (or in this case heard) before. 

The double-feature of «The Final Hour / Shimmer» is available NOW!!!
